# Dularis

> Dularis is a Lagos, Nigeria–based agency. We help businesses build stronger brands, establish a professional digital presence, and grow through strategy, technology, and creative solutions.

Dularis serves clients globally, not limited to Nigeria, and works across both digital and offline brand materials.

## Company

- Name: Dularis
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria
- Website: https://dularis.com
- Email: info@dularis.com
- Phone: +234 906 848 4193
- Slogan: Transforming Brands. Empowering Businesses.
- Core values: Integrity, Creativity, Excellence

## Services

Dularis offers 19 services across three pillars: website development, digital marketing, and brand/corporate communication materials. Core services include:

- Website Development
- Digital Marketing
- Social Media Management
- SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
- Digital Advertising (Meta Ads, Google Ads)
- Brand Strategy & Positioning
- Graphics Design
- Corporate Profile & Document Design
- Photography & Videography

Full service list: https://dularis.com/services.html

## Packages

Dularis offers three engagement tiers, each combining website, marketing, and brand management:

- Essential Package
- Growth Package
- Enterprise Package (custom scope)

## Leadership

Dularis is led by three co-founders, each serving as Co-CEO:

- Olamilekan Ajibesin — Co-CEO, Brand Communication Strategist
- Biodun Shittu — Co-CEO, Brand Development Strategist
- Adedoyin David Taiwo — Co-CEO, Technical Director
